sloka: स मातामहम् आपृच्च्य मातुलम् च युधा जितम् ।रथम् आरुह्य भरतः शत्रुघ्न सहितः ययौ ॥२-७०-२४॥
transliteration: sa mātāmaham āpṛccya mātulam ca yudhā jitam ।ratham āruhya bharataḥ śatrughna sahitaḥ yayau ॥2-70-24॥

translations.english: All the wealth given by the king of Kekaya did not delight Bharata, son of Kaikeyi who was in a hurry to depart for Ayodhya.
